# Find where the job moved.

> Compare estimated and actual job hours and costs to find the largest job cost variance before your next contractor quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/job-margin-variance/)

- [This calculator vs. QuickBooks Job Costing](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/job-margin-variance/vs-quickbooks-job-costing.html)
- [Why did my job cost more than I estimated?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/job-margin-variance/why-did-my-job-cost-more-than-i-estimated.html)
